text: Git cannot identify the author of uncommitted changes. Attribute them by comparing file changes with session history, worktree paths, reflog, and saved recovery artifacts. In this case `[local path]` had staged Bug 2061199 changes and one unresolved `calendarEventCreateEditDialog.xhtml` left by an interrupted patch application; it had no active rebase metadata. [Task 1]
title: Commands rebase responsiveness and Thunderbird checkout forensics
